reasoning.step1:
Document classification:
- Contains "RECHNUNG" and "Fakturendatum" — strong invoice indicators.
- No exclusion terms like "Zahlungserinnerung" or "Mahnung" prominent.
- Proceed with extraction.

Locate candidate fields in text:
- Invoice number present ("Nr. 230815") — confirms invoice layout.
- Invoice date labeled "Fakturendatum: 12.07.2023" → Invoice.Date = "12.07.2023".
- Sender VAT appears near top/right: "ATU61609708" → Sender.VatId = "ATU61609708".
- Grand total shown as "RECHNUNGSBETRAG EUR 1.006,56" → GrandTotal.Amount = 1006.56.

VAT group identification:
- Text shows VAT lines:
  - "MWSt. 10,00 %"
  - "MWSt. 13,00 %"
  - "MWSt. 20,00 % Bem: 838,80 Ust. 167,76"
- Compute/check: 20% of 838,80 = 167,76 matches provided Ust. value. The 10% and 13% lines have no associated amounts shown meaningfully.
- Per rule to include only invoice-level exchange rates and VAT groups: treat the 20% group as the VAT group for the invoice.

Assign final numeric values preserving decimals:
- Net.Amount = 838.80 (from "Bem: 838,80")
- Vat.Amount = 167.76 (from "Ust. 167,76")
- Vat.Rate = 20 (percentage without %)

No inference beyond visible data; other VAT rates present but without amounts -> omitted.
reasoning.step2:
Confidence evaluation:

- Document classification as invoice: High confidence. Evidence: prominent header "RECHNUNG", "Fakturendatum", invoice number "Nr. 230815", line items, totals. No exclusion keywords present.

- Invoice.Date = "12.07.2023": Very high confidence. Exact labeled field "Fakturendatum: 12.07.2023" appears clearly.

- Sender.VatId = "ATU61609708": Very high confidence. VAT ID appears twice (near top right and in footer as "Ust - Idnr.: ATU61609708"), identical.

- GrandTotal.Amount = 1006.56: High confidence. Text shows "RECHNUNGSBETRAG EUR 1.006,56" matching sum of NETTOBETRAG 838,80 + UST 167,76 = 1.006,56. Decimal and comma format consistent.

- Vat.Rate = 20: Moderate-to-high confidence. Three MWSt lines appear (10,00%; 13,00%; 20,00%). Only the 20,00% line includes explicit "Bem: 838,80 Ust. 167,76" tying amounts to that rate. Thus selecting 20% is supported.

- Net.Amount = 838.80: High confidence. Explicit "Bem: 838,80" on the 20% MWSt line and NETTOBETRAG shown as EUR 838,80 in totals area.

- Vat.Amount = 167.76: High confidence. Explicit "Ust. 167,76" next to the 20% MWSt line and UST GESAMT 167,76 shown.

Notes on alternatives / uncertainties:
- Alternative interpretation would be including multiple VAT groups (10% and 13%), but those lines lack associated net/VAT amounts. Rule forbids guessing; therefore only the 20% group with explicit amounts is used.
- Number formatting uses comma as decimal separator in source; converted to period for numeric values—confidence that numeric conversion is correct is high.
